brief.aim: The table is the UCI dry bean morphological dataset: 16 numeric shape descriptors of individually segmented seeds plus a 7-level nominal Class label, which is the evident purpose of the collection, so the natural study is multiclass classification of bean variety from morphology, scored by the workflow's default metric.
brief.repeated_subjects: No repeated-subject structure; each row corresponds to a distinct bean and no source unit repeats.
brief.unit: One dry bean (a single segmented seed image summarized by geometric shape measurements)
